metaTitle: Airtable to Webflow Integration Guide | B2B Sync
metaDescription: Learn how to seamlessly sync Airtable records to Webflow CMS collections with automated triggers, zero code, and Make middleware.
topUseCases: Auto-publish programmatic SEO landing pages from curated Airtable tables.
Sync multi-author blog drafts and asset attachments into Webflow CMS items.
Update product inventory and pricing on live marketing pages without designer intervention.
stepByStepGuide: Generate an Airtable Personal Access Token (PAT) with data.records:read scopes.
Create an API Token in Webflow Site Settings under the Integrations tab.
In Make (formerly Integromat), create a scenario starting with the 'Airtable - Watch Records' trigger module.
Add the 'Webflow - Create/Update Item' action module and map table fields to CMS collection schema.
Enable instant Webhook triggers in Airtable and turn on the Make scenario schedule.
commonPitfalls: Hitting Webflow's rate limit of 60 requests/minute during bulk imports from Airtable without a pacing delay.
Field type mismatches (e.g. multi-reference IDs vs plain text slugs) causing silent CMS item creation failures.

metaTitle: HubSpot to Slack Integration Guide (Native Sync)
metaDescription: Connect HubSpot to Slack to receive real-time deal alerts, lead notifications, and trigger slash commands directly inside Slack channels.
topUseCases: Post real-time notifications to #sales-wins when high-value deals enter 'Closed Won'.
Assign inbound leads immediately by alerting reps in designated rep channels.
Search CRM contacts and log meeting notes directly from Slack using /hubspot commands.
stepByStepGuide: Navigate to HubSpot App Marketplace and search for the official Slack integration.
Click 'Install app' and authorize permissions for your target Slack workspace.
Under HubSpot Settings > Integrations > Connected Apps, configure default channel notifications.
Create a HubSpot Workflow to trigger conditional Slack channel messages based on Deal Stage updates.
commonPitfalls: Over-notifying general channels with low-priority lead changes, creating notification fatigue.
Failing to map individual HubSpot user accounts to Slack users, preventing direct @mentions in alerts.

metaTitle: Stripe to QuickBooks Online Integration Guide
metaDescription: Automate invoice reconciliation, subscription payments, and customer records between Stripe and QuickBooks Online via Zapier.
topUseCases: Auto-generate Sales Receipts in QuickBooks whenever a successful Stripe charge occurs.
Deduct Stripe processing fees automatically into a designated COGS expense account.
Sync customer billing addresses and tax identification numbers for global compliance.
stepByStepGuide: Connect your Stripe account with restricted API read keys for charge and customer events.
Authenticate QuickBooks Online in Zapier using company admin credentials.
Create a Zap triggered by 'New Successful Charge in Stripe'.
Add a 'Find or Create Customer in QuickBooks Online' search step to avoid duplicate contacts.
Configure 'Create Sales Receipt' action with split lines for gross revenue and Stripe merchant processing fees.
commonPitfalls: Omitting Stripe fee line items, leading to discrepancies between bank deposits and book revenue totals.
Failing to account for refund events, resulting in overstated gross revenue numbers in QuickBooks.

metaTitle: Salesforce to Notion Integration Tutorial
metaDescription: Sync Salesforce accounts, opportunities, and key pipeline metrics into Notion databases for team-wide cross-functional visibility.
topUseCases: Maintain a real-time account directory in Notion for non-Salesforce licensed product and CS teams.
Embed live quarterly pipeline rollups inside company all-hands workspace documents.
Trigger kickoff project workspaces in Notion when an Enterprise deal closes in Salesforce.
stepByStepGuide: Create a Connected App in Salesforce with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials.
Build an internal integration token in Notion and share target database pages with the integration.
Set up a Make webhook listener receiving Salesforce Outbound Messages or CDC (Change Data Capture) events.
Map Salesforce Opportunity fields (Amount, Stage, Close Date, Owner) to Notion database properties.
Add error handling paths for custom field validation and rate-limit retries.
commonPitfalls: Syncing too many granular SFDC fields into Notion, hitting database block limits and slowing Notion search.
Not accounting for Salesforce sandboxes vs production instance URLs during OAuth configuration.

metaTitle: Linear to Slack Integration Guide (Native)
metaDescription: Streamline engineering notifications by syncing Linear issue updates, PR links, and project roadmaps directly to your team Slack channels.
topUseCases: Broadcast urgent P0/Triage issues into engineering on-call channels immediately.
Allow team members to create Linear issues directly from Slack messages with one click.
Sync personal issue assignees with Slack personal DMs for review reminders.
stepByStepGuide: Open Linear Settings and navigate to 'Integrations' > 'Slack'.
Click 'Connect to Slack' and authorize the Linear bot in your workspace.
Configure project-level and team-level channel notification rules.
Enable the Slack shortcut 'Create Linear Issue' for seamless task filing from chat threads.
commonPitfalls: Subscribing high-activity team backlogs to high-traffic channels without filtering by priority or label.
Forgetting to link individual Linear accounts to Slack users for personalized direct notification routing.

metaTitle: Shopify to Klaviyo Sync & Setup Guide
metaDescription: Integrate Shopify with Klaviyo to automate abandoned cart emails, customer segment tracking, and purchase revenue analytics in real-time.
topUseCases: Trigger personalized abandoned checkout and abandoned browse email sequences.
Segment VIP customers dynamically based on historical Lifetime Value (LTV) and order frequencies.
Sync onsite SMS opt-in phone numbers with checkout compliance timestamps.
stepByStepGuide: Install the official Klaviyo app from the Shopify App Store.
Check 'Automatically add Klaviyo onsite JavaScript' and select sync historical data options.
Configure SMS marketing compliance disclosures in Shopify Checkout settings.
Verify tracking by triggering a test 'Started Checkout' event in an incognito browser window.
commonPitfalls: Neglecting GDPR/TCPA compliance checkboxes, resulting in un-subscribed contacts receiving promotional SMS.
Not waiting for historical order data sync to complete before launching automated segment-based flows.

metaTitle: Zendesk to Jira Service Management Sync
metaDescription: Connect Zendesk customer tickets to Jira development issues to streamline cross-team bug resolution and status updates automatically.
topUseCases: Escalate customer bug reports from Zendesk tickets into Jira engineering backlog issues.
Sync Jira issue status transitions back to Zendesk tickets as internal agent notes.
Allow support agents to track engineering progress without requiring full Jira seat licenses.
stepByStepGuide: Install the Zendesk Support app for Jira from Atlassian Marketplace.
Install the Jira Cloud app in the Zendesk Support Admin Center.
Authorize bi-directional permissions between your Atlassian and Zendesk instances.
Map Jira issue types (Bug, Task, Story) and priority levels to Zendesk ticket types.
Enable automated two-way comment synchronization and status change notifications.
commonPitfalls: Accidentally syncing private engineering Jira comments back to end-users as public Zendesk replies.
Missing custom field definitions in Jira, causing issue creation errors when triggered from Zendesk.

metaTitle: Intercom to Salesforce Integration Guide
metaDescription: Sync Intercom conversational leads, conversation transcripts, and visitor data directly to Salesforce CRM leads and contacts natively.
topUseCases: Automatically create or update Salesforce Leads when qualification bots capture visitor contact info.
Log completed Intercom conversation transcripts as Salesforce Task activities on Contact records.
Route VIP Salesforce Accounts directly to dedicated account reps when they initiate live chat.
stepByStepGuide: In Intercom App Store, select the Salesforce app and authenticate with a Salesforce System Administrator user.
Map Intercom visitor data fields (Email, Company, Industry) to standard and custom Salesforce Lead fields.
Define duplicate management rules to update existing records rather than creating duplicate Leads.
Enable real-time activity logging for chat transcripts, qualification events, and meeting bookings.
commonPitfalls: Failing to respect Salesforce required validation rules on Lead creation, causing silent sync rejections.
Assigning the integration user insufficient Field-Level Security (FLS) permissions in Salesforce.

metaTitle: GitHub to Linear Integration & PR Sync
metaDescription: Connect GitHub pull requests, commits, and branch workflows directly to Linear issues for automated sprint tracking and issue resolution.
topUseCases: Automatically move Linear issues to 'In Progress' when a git branch with the issue identifier is pushed.
Attach GitHub Pull Request status, review approvals, and CI check status directly on Linear cards.
Close Linear issues automatically when corresponding pull requests are merged into the default branch.
stepByStepGuide: Open Linear Settings > Integrations > GitHub.
Click 'Install GitHub App' and select the specific repositories or entire GitHub organization to connect.
Configure automation rules for branch creation, draft pull requests, and PR merge behaviors.
Copy branch names from Linear issues with git branch prefixes for seamless linking.
commonPitfalls: Omitting the Linear issue key (e.g. ENG-123) in branch names or PR titles, breaking the automatic association.
Connecting an entire enterprise GitHub org without repository filtering, syncing unintended internal repos.

metaTitle: PostgreSQL to Google Sheets Data Pipeline
metaDescription: Automate scheduled exports and query syncs from PostgreSQL databases into Google Sheets for executive reporting without SQL scripts.
topUseCases: Push daily transactional metrics and MRR summaries to leadership spreadsheets automatically.
Sync customer cohort segments into Google Sheets for marketing team ad-hoc analysis.
Trigger alert rows whenever abnormal error counts or spikes are detected in production tables.
stepByStepGuide: Create a read-only database user in PostgreSQL with SELECT-only grants on target tables or views.
Whitelist Zapier / middleware IP addresses in your database firewall or cloud security group.
Set up a Zapier trigger using 'New or Updated Row in PostgreSQL' or a scheduled query interval.
Select the target Google Spreadsheet and Sheet tab.
Map returned SQL columns to corresponding Google Sheet column headers with append or upsert logic.
commonPitfalls: Granting write or administrative permissions to the integration user instead of strict read-only access.
Querying unindexed, massive tables on short polling schedules, creating high CPU load on the production database.

metaTitle: Typeform to Slack Integration Guide (Real-Time Sync)
metaDescription: Route Typeform responses instantly to Slack channels to alert sales reps, triage support, and capture leads without delays.
topUseCases: Send immediate notifications to #inbound-leads whenever a high-intent prospect submits a form.
Post NPS feedback and customer survey ratings to team feedback channels for transparent visibility.
Route support ticket intake submissions to dedicated on-call response channels.
stepByStepGuide: Open your target form in Typeform and navigate to the 'Connect' tab.
Search for the native Slack integration and click 'Connect'.
Authenticate with your Slack workspace and choose the destination channel for form submissions.
Select which form fields to include in the preview payload message.
Send a test submission from Typeform to verify that the message format and mentions render properly in Slack.
commonPitfalls: Connecting multiple high-traffic survey forms to a single public channel, resulting in message spam.
Excluding required field answers from the notification card, forcing reps to log in to Typeform to view responses.

metaTitle: Stripe to HubSpot CRM Integration Guide
metaDescription: Sync customer payment details, active subscriptions, and lifetime value metrics from Stripe into HubSpot CRM contact records.
topUseCases: Equip account executives with real-time MRR, subscription tier, and payment status directly inside HubSpot contact timelines.
Trigger automated churn recovery workflows in HubSpot when a Stripe charge fails or invoice is overdue.
Enroll high-value customers into VIP onboarding campaigns upon successful first subscription payment.
stepByStepGuide: Navigate to the HubSpot App Marketplace and search for 'Stripe by HubSpot'.
Click 'Install app' and log in to your Stripe account to grant read permissions.
Choose whether to sync Stripe customers, invoices, and subscriptions to HubSpot contacts and deals.
Configure custom field mapping between Stripe metadata and HubSpot custom contact properties.
Test with a test charge in Stripe to confirm that payment events populate on the HubSpot contact record.
commonPitfalls: Failing to match Stripe customer emails with HubSpot primary contact emails, creating detached transaction records.
Allowing failed charges to create duplicate contacts without deduplication rules enabled.

metaTitle: Jira to Slack Integration Tutorial (Native Connect)
metaDescription: Connect Jira Cloud to Slack to receive automated issue updates, assign backlog tickets, and transition issues without leaving chat.
topUseCases: Notify sprint channels when P0 blockers are logged or assigned to team members.
Transition issue status (e.g. In Review to Done) directly from interactive Slack notification cards.
Create new Jira tickets from Slack messages using message actions or /jira commands.
stepByStepGuide: In Slack, install the official 'Jira Cloud' app from the Slack App Directory.
Authorize your Atlassian account and link your Jira workspace.
In your project Slack channel, run '/jira connect' to bind the channel to your Jira project.
Set notification filters to only send alerts for specific issue types, priority levels, or status changes.
Test by creating a sample issue in Jira and verifying the interactive action buttons in Slack.
commonPitfalls: Subscribing a channel to all Jira issue changes without priority filtering, causing notification blindness.
Forgetting to map individual Jira accounts to Slack users, preventing assigned assignees from being @mentioned.

metaTitle: Asana to GitHub Integration Guide | Project & Code Sync
metaDescription: Link Asana tasks to GitHub pull requests and commits to automate sprint progress updates and status synchronization.
topUseCases: Automatically attach GitHub PR review status, build checks, and branch information to Asana task cards.
Move Asana tasks across Kanban board columns when linked GitHub pull requests are merged.
Allow product managers to track engineering completion without needing direct repository access.
stepByStepGuide: In Asana, open the project where you want to enable the integration and click 'Customize' in the top right.
Select 'Apps' and choose 'GitHub' from the list of available integrations.
Authenticate with your GitHub account and choose which repositories to grant access to.
Add the Asana task URL or task ID to your GitHub commit message or PR description.
Verify that the GitHub widget appears on the Asana task card showing live PR status.
commonPitfalls: Not including the full Asana task link in the PR description, preventing the automated status hook from firing.
Granting organization-wide GitHub permissions when only specific repositories need to be linked.

metaTitle: Calendly to HubSpot CRM Integration Guide
metaDescription: Automatically create HubSpot CRM contacts, log booked meetings, and update lead pipeline stages when prospects book via Calendly.
topUseCases: Instantly create new HubSpot contacts and log meeting details when a prospect schedules an intro call.
Assign contact ownership based on which team member's Calendly round-robin calendar was booked.
Trigger pre-meeting reminder emails and sales collateral workflows in HubSpot.
stepByStepGuide: Log into Calendly and navigate to Integrations > HubSpot.
Click 'Connect HubSpot' and log in to authorize access to your HubSpot portal.
Configure mapping settings for contact creation, meeting activity logging, and custom questions.
Set lead routing rules to assign contact owner based on the booked host.
Schedule a test booking through your Calendly link and confirm that the meeting and contact appear in HubSpot.
commonPitfalls: Not mapping custom Calendly booking questions to custom HubSpot contact properties, losing qualifying data.
Overwriting existing high-tier deal stages with standard intro meeting stages on repeat bookings.

metaTitle: Airtable to Slack Automation Blueprint
metaDescription: Send rich, automated Slack notifications and digest summaries when Airtable base records are created, modified, or approved.
topUseCases: Broadcast deal approvals, content calendar publish events, or inventory alerts to target Slack channels.
Send automated weekly digest summaries of open high-priority tasks to operational channels.
Alert project leads when critical status fields in an Airtable table change to 'Blocked' or 'Needs Review'.
stepByStepGuide: Open your Airtable base and click the 'Automations' tab in the top navigation.
Create a new automation and choose a trigger (e.g. 'When a record matches conditions' or 'When record enters view').
Add an action step and select 'Slack: Send a message'.
Authenticate your Slack account and select the target channel or direct message recipient.
Compose the message body using dynamic record tokens (e.g. Record Name, Status, Owner, URL) and turn on the automation.
commonPitfalls: Using 'When record is updated' without strict view filters, triggering dozens of Slack alerts while a user is actively typing.
Hardcoding channel IDs that break if channels are renamed or archived.

metaTitle: Zendesk to Slack Integration Guide (Real-Time Alerts)
metaDescription: Streamline customer support response times by forwarding urgent Zendesk tickets, VIP customer inquiries, and SLA alerts to Slack.
topUseCases: Notify on-call engineers in Slack when urgent P1 tickets or SLA breach warnings are triggered in Zendesk.
Post positive CSAT ratings and customer feedback snippets to company-wide celebration channels.
Allow support agents to discuss complex customer tickets in dedicated Slack threads before replying in Zendesk.
stepByStepGuide: In Zendesk Admin Center, go to Apps and Integrations > Slack integration.
Click 'Install' and authorize your company Slack workspace.
Configure channel triggers in Zendesk by defining ticket conditions (e.g. Priority = Urgent, Status = New).
Customize notification payloads to include ticket summary, requester email, and direct link.
Create a test ticket in Zendesk with Urgent priority to verify delivery in the selected Slack channel.
commonPitfalls: Routing all incoming tickets without priority filters to Slack, overwhelming agents with noise.
Failing to restrict Slack message visibility when handling tickets containing sensitive customer PII.

metaTitle: DocuSign to Salesforce CRM Integration Guide
metaDescription: Automate contract execution by sending DocuSign agreements from Salesforce opportunities and auto-updating deal stages upon signature.
topUseCases: Generate custom sales contracts with pre-populated Salesforce opportunity and account data in one click.
Automatically update Salesforce opportunity status to 'Closed Won' immediately upon final signature.
Attach signed PDF agreements automatically to Salesforce Opportunity and Account file attachments.
stepByStepGuide: Install 'DocuSign eSignature for Salesforce' from the Salesforce AppExchange.
Log into Salesforce Setup, find DocuSign Admin, and connect your DocuSign production account.
Create an Envelope Template and map Salesforce Opportunity fields to DocuSign document tags.
Add a DocuSign custom action button to the Salesforce Opportunity page layout.
Configure write-back settings to update stage field and attach completed documents upon envelope completion.
commonPitfalls: Not configuring Salesforce IP allowlists, causing DocuSign Connect webhook callbacks to fail silently.
Missing write-back permissions on custom Opportunity fields for the DocuSign system integration user.

metaTitle: Webflow to Notion Integration Tutorial (Make Workflow)
metaDescription: Sync Webflow form submissions and incoming leads automatically into structured Notion databases using Make middleware.
topUseCases: Collect and organize inbound website contact form inquiries in a shared team Notion database.
Maintain a real-time log of customer feedback and feature requests submitted through Webflow landing pages.
Assign follow-up tasks in Notion to team members based on form submission categories.
stepByStepGuide: In Webflow Project Settings > Integrations, configure a Webhook for 'Form Submission'.
In Make, create a new scenario starting with a Custom Webhook module and copy the webhook URL into Webflow.
Submit a test form entry on your published Webflow site to determine the payload schema in Make.
Add the 'Notion - Create a Database Item' module and connect your Notion workspace.
Map Webflow form submission fields (Name, Email, Message, Submission Date) to your Notion database properties and activate the scenario.
commonPitfalls: Failing to publish the Webflow site after adding the webhook, resulting in webhook triggers not firing.
Not granting the Notion integration connection explicit access to the specific target database page.

metaTitle: Snowflake to Salesforce Data Sync Guide (Reverse ETL)
metaDescription: Sync aggregated customer usage metrics, product-qualified lead scores, and billing stats from Snowflake into Salesforce CRM.
topUseCases: Empower sales reps with product usage data (e.g. active seats, feature adoption, weekly logins) inside Salesforce.
Sync computed Product Qualified Lead (PQL) scores from data warehouse models to prioritize sales outreach.
Keep account billing status, tier consumption, and enterprise usage limits up-to-date in CRM records.
stepByStepGuide: Create a dedicated read-only service account in Snowflake with SELECT privileges on reporting views.
In Salesforce, create custom fields on Account and Contact objects to store warehouse attributes.
In Make / Reverse ETL pipeline, configure the Snowflake connector with warehouse name, database, and schema.
Write a scheduled query module in Make that fetches updated customer metrics.
Map query output columns to Salesforce Account custom fields using Upsert operations keyed on Salesforce Account ID.
commonPitfalls: Running un-partitioned full table scans on large Snowflake tables every hour, generating excessive compute credits.
Hitting Salesforce Daily API request limits during bulk updates instead of batching updates.

metaTitle: Shopify to QuickBooks Online Sync Guide
metaDescription: Sync Shopify orders, inventory adjustments, and payouts to QuickBooks Online automatically with Zapier or native connectors.
topUseCases: Automatically generate Sales Receipts in QuickBooks Online for every fulfilled Shopify order.
Track sales tax collected across multiple state jurisdictions in designated liability accounts.
Reconcile Shopify Payments daily deposit batches against merchant bank payouts.
stepByStepGuide: In Zapier or QuickBooks App Store, connect your Shopify store and QuickBooks Online organization.
Choose a trigger event: 'New Paid Order in Shopify'.
Configure the customer matching step to search for existing QuickBooks customers by email before creating new ones.
Map order line items, shipping charges, discounts, and sales tax to corresponding QuickBooks Chart of Accounts items.
Run a test transaction from Shopify and review the created Sales Receipt in QuickBooks Online.
commonPitfalls: Creating duplicate customer records by not configuring an exact email lookup step before creation.
Failing to map discount codes and gift card redemptions to dedicated contra-revenue accounts.

metaTitle: ClickUp to Slack Integration & Notification Guide
metaDescription: Connect ClickUp to Slack to create tasks from messages, receive instant task updates, and unfurl task details in team channels.
topUseCases: Convert Slack message discussions directly into ClickUp tasks using the 'Create Task' message action.
Broadcast task status transitions and task completion milestones to dedicated project channels.
Unfurl ClickUp task previews (assignee, priority, due date, description) automatically when links are pasted.
stepByStepGuide: In ClickUp, go to Workspace Settings > Integrations > Slack.
Click 'Add to Slack' and authorize permissions for your Slack workspace.
Map specific ClickUp Spaces or Folders to target Slack public or private channels.
Choose which event notifications (New Task, Status Change, Comment Added) should trigger channel alerts.
Test by creating a task in ClickUp and confirming the alert card in Slack.
commonPitfalls: Enabling comment notifications on active tasks in public channels, creating excessive chatter.
Connecting private ClickUp Folders to public Slack channels, potentially exposing confidential project info.

metaTitle: Notion to Google Sheets Data Sync Guide (Make Scenario)
metaDescription: Sync structured Notion database rows into Google Sheets spreadsheets automatically for financial modeling, reporting, and backup.
topUseCases: Export roadmap deliverables and task timelines from Notion into Google Sheets for executive KPI dashboards.
Back up mission-critical Notion database records to external Google Sheet spreadsheets on a daily schedule.
Perform complex formula modeling and pivot chart analysis on live Notion database entries.
stepByStepGuide: In Notion, share your target database with your Make internal integration connection.
In Make, add the 'Notion - Watch Database Items' trigger module and select the target database ID.
Add the 'Google Sheets - Add a Row' action module and authenticate your Google account.
Select the destination spreadsheet and sheet tab name.
Map Notion property values (Title, Status, Dates, Multi-Select tags) to spreadsheet column headers and turn on the schedule.
commonPitfalls: Forgetting to share the specific Notion page/database with the Make connection in Notion page settings.
Not handling multi-select array values properly, causing comma-separated arrays to format incorrectly in sheet cells.

metaTitle: Google Forms to Trello Automation Guide (Zapier Zap)
metaDescription: Turn Google Forms submissions into visual Trello Kanban cards automatically with mapped fields, assignees, and due dates.
topUseCases: Create incoming project request cards on a team triage Trello board whenever a client submits an intake form.
Route internal IT helpdesk and hardware request forms into support backlog cards automatically.
Assign team members and due dates on Trello cards based on user responses in Google Forms.
stepByStepGuide: In Google Forms, link your form responses to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
In Zapier, create a Zap triggered by 'New Response in Google Forms' (or New Spreadsheet Row).
Connect your Trello account and select the destination Board and List (e.g. 'Incoming Requests').
Map Form responses to Trello Card Name, Description, Due Date, and Label properties.
Submit a test response in Google Forms and verify that the Trello card appears on the board.
commonPitfalls: Not linking Google Forms to a Google Sheet first, which can delay webhook trigger speeds in Zapier.
Overloading card titles with full form answers instead of formatting them cleanly in the card description.

metaTitle: Mailchimp to Shopify E-Commerce Sync Guide
metaDescription: Connect Mailchimp to Shopify to sync customer purchase history, automate abandoned cart emails, and track marketing ROI.
topUseCases: Sync customer newsletter opt-ins and marketing consent collected during Shopify checkout.
Trigger automated abandoned cart recovery email series with dynamic product images and checkout links.
Segment email subscribers based on lifetime spend, total order count, and purchase recency.
stepByStepGuide: In the Shopify App Store, install the official 'Mailchimp for Shopify' app.
Log into your Mailchimp account and select the target audience list to connect.
Configure store sync settings to sync customer contacts, store products, promo codes, and past order history.
Enable e-commerce tracking in Mailchimp and set up the Abandoned Cart customer journey.
Place a test order or initiate a test checkout on Shopify to verify subscriber sync in Mailchimp.
commonPitfalls: Syncing non-marketing opted-in customers to marketing lists without double opt-in compliance.
Running simultaneous abandoned cart automations in both Shopify native email and Mailchimp, double-emailing customers.
